create_LVISEvaluator: create an LVISEvaluator instance for a named dataset with optional tasks and output directory
process_predictions: process model inputs and outputs to collect LVIS predictions for later evaluation
evaluate_predictions: evaluate collected LVIS predictions and return AP metrics for bbox or segm tasks
evaluate_box_proposals: evaluate detection box proposal recall metrics across area ranges and proposal limits
evaluate_on_lvis: run LVIS evaluation on predictions using LVISEval and return per-category AP scores
